game_concept: A speed quiz set in Coastal Port – Cliffside Fort, a fort on the sea cliffs: the fisher must handle rogue waves while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Elif Ladder: Rank threats with an if/elif/else ladder and send the right response to each.
theme: Coastal Port – Cliffside Fort: a fort on the sea cliffs
core_gameplay_loop: In Cliffside Fort, repeat each round: Rank threats with an if/elif/else ladder and send the right response to each. Each round, a new lanterns challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the threat_level value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 380 points of lanterns by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 380, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 8 (extended tier): Elif Ladder
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Elif Ladder' (Week 3 slot 3), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Cliffside Fort'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how threat_level changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue waves in Cliffside Fort.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 380 within 51 seconds.
